source.description: Globs (root-relative POSIX) that count as source. Default: every non-ignored file except docs/** and **/*.md. The gate's own state, node_modules, .git and .gitignore never count.

tests.description: Globs for test files. Default: **/{tests,test,__tests__,spec}/** and **/*.{test,spec}.*

ui.description: Globs whose change requires driving the real surface (R4). Default: **/*.{tsx,vue,svelte}

schema.description: Globs whose change requires a real-schema probe (R6). Default: none.

docs.description: Globs treated as documentation (zero-friction path). Default: docs/** and **/*.md

highRisk.description: Globs whose change requires the second reviewer (R9). Default: none.

verify.description: Commands `gate verify` runs, in order. Default: the lint, typecheck, test and build scripts that exist in package.json.

when.description: When the command runs: always; only when a non-test, non-doc source file changed (source); or as the final check, run once with `gate verify --final` and owed until it is green on the current implementation (final). Default: source for a single npm/pnpm/yarn/bun build script call, always otherwise.

onlyNew.description: For a linter that prints findings as path:line or path(line,col): an exit 1 whose findings all lie in files of this repo and off the lines this task changed counts green, and the report lists the old findings it ignored. A crash, any other exit code, a place outside the repo's source files or in a test file, output past 2 MB, or a command that runs tests stays red. It reads lines, not causes: for line-local linters (flake8, ruff, eslint -f unix), not tsc or mypy. Default: false.

related.description: Run testFiles on this task's related test files (closed cases' test files, changed test files, and test files that reference a changed module by its folder or package). Goes by the name `related tests`. Needs testFiles.

checks.description: Named repo checks run at every Stop (R10).

slop.description: Scan the task's added lines for greppable slop (banner comments, step narration, empty labels, end markers, emoji, bare TODOs, @param echoes) at every Stop while a ledger is open; test files are not scanned (R10). Default: true. Change it between tasks; mid-task a false positive is waived with `gate waive slop`.

driver.description: "skill:verify" once /done-gate:verify-setup has generated .claude/skills/verify/, or "cmd:<command>" (e.g. "cmd:npx playwright test") when a command run by the lead drives the surface; null otherwise. Changing this key mid-task is not a config change.

helperNote.description: A standing note for every helper, printed in each packet under "## Standing note" (e.g. "Never run two test runs at once: they share tests/.tmp"). Changing it mid-task is a config change (R13).

testFiles.description: The command that runs given test files, with {files} where they go (e.g. "npx vitest run {files}"). `gate test <test files>` runs it, and a fresh-verify reviewer packet names the exact `gate test` line. Changing it mid-task is a config change (R13). null records that the user declined the faster test loop, so session start does not propose it again.

serialTests.description: true when test runs must not overlap (one shared test database or folder): `gate test` and `gate verify` take one repo-wide lock and wait their turn, and helper packets say to run tests only through `gate test`. Changing it mid-task is a config change (R13).
